question_text: Are all refrigeration units maintaining proper temperature (0-4 C for fridge -18 C for freezer)?
Are food contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized between uses?
Are handwashing stations properly stocked and used by staff?
Are food items properly labeled with date and time?
Is the FIFO (First In First Out) system being followed?
Is the order accuracy rate above 95%?
Is the average wait time under 3 minutes?
Are staff greeting customers with a smile?
Is the dining area clean and well-maintained?
Are complaints being logged and resolved?
Are washrooms clean and fully stocked?
Is the dining floor free of debris and spills?
Are trash bins emptied regularly?
Is the exterior signage and parking area well-maintained?
Are all staff in proper uniform with name badges?
Are training records up to date for all staff?
Is the shift schedule posted and followed?
Are food safety certifications current?
Are all kitchen equipment in working condition?
Is the maintenance log up to date?
Are fire extinguishers inspected and accessible?
Is the HVAC system functioning properly?
